Lead generation is the process of attracting, nurturing, and converting prospects into potential customers who have expressed interest in your products or services.
Reputable agencies build data-handling processes around PDPA’s consent, purpose limitation, and notification obligations from the outset, not as an afterthought.
This includes AI-driven prospect research tools, intent-data platforms, automated outreach sequencing, and predictive lead-scoring models.
iSmart uses a structured six-step methodology, the iSmart Pipeline Accelerator Framework, rather than ad hoc outreach, giving clients a repeatable, measurable process.
The framework is designed to scale across Bootstrap, Growth, and Enterprise budget levels, so it fits businesses at different stages rather than a one-size-fits-all package.
